original.target_description: Experiment 1: prime-consistent temporal interpretation after ego/object spatial primes; chi-square consistency test

n.exclusions: Seven participants answered prime questions incorrectly and were omitted; unprimed controls excluded from chi-square.

replication.target_description: Study 2: ego versus object spatial prime and Monday/Friday response; primed participants only, excluding control

n.sample_role: participants included in target aggregate analysis
n.exclusions: Excluded incorrect answers to any of four prime questions and non-Monday/non-Friday target responses. Control N = 856 excluded from target contrast.

reported_success.quote: the replications were nonetheless consistent with the key feature of the original demonstration: object-priming increased the likelihood of selecting Monday compared to Friday.

notes: Analytic n is 1,335 primed participants, not total in-lab N = 2,191 including control. No standardized effect size printed for original target chi-square; statistic retained separately. OCR mathematical encoding preserved in quote; N=56 is target analytic sample, not recruited total 98.
